content: {"paper_id":"W2763694500","annotations":[{"keyword_id":"semi-supervised-learning","exact_quote":"In a semi-supervised setting, direct training of a deep discriminative model on partially labeled images often suffers from overfitting and poor performance","evidence_field":"abstract","reason_zh":"论文明确以半监督图像分类为任务，利用少量已标注图像和大量未标注图像训练模型。"},{"keyword_id":"deep-clustering","exact_quote":"we propose a cross-task network composed of two streams to jointly learn two tasks: classification and clustering.","evidence_field":"abstract","reason_zh":"通过可学习的双流交叉任务网络联合学习聚类任务，并由网络获得聚类划分，满足深度聚类定义。"},{"keyword_id":"weakly-supervised-learning","exact_quote":"Since pairwise constraints encode weak supervision information, the clustering is tolerant of errors in labeling.","evidence_field":"abstract","reason_zh":"论文将模型预测生成的成对约束作为弱监督信息用于聚类，并研究其容忍标注错误的特性。"},{"keyword_id":"pseudo-label-self-training","exact_quote":"Based on the model predictions, a large number of pairwise constraints can be generated from unlabeled images, and are fed to the clustering stream.","evidence_field":"abstract","reason_zh":"模型对未标注图像的预测被转化为成对约束并馈入聚类流，作为后续训练信号，属于自训练机制。"}],"abstentions":[{"keyword_id":"pairwise-constraint-propagation","reason_zh":"摘要只说明从模型预测生成成对约束并输入聚类流，未说明对must-link/cannot-link关系进行扩展或传播，故不足以判定为成对约束传播。"}],"input_issues":[]}
